## Summary

Describe the problem and the change in one or two paragraphs.

## What changed

- [ ] Client behavior
- [ ] Server behavior
- [ ] Database schema or migration
- [ ] Documentation or configuration
- [ ] Tests

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results.

```text
pnpm check
pnpm test
pnpm build
```

## Compatibility and operations

Describe environment-variable changes, deployment considerations, migration steps, scheduling behavior, and known limitations.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, session tokens, private source material, or production data are included.
- [ ] Authentication, authorization, input validation, and external-content handling were reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] Any security impact is documented above.

## Documentation

- [ ] README or other documentation updated when behavior or setup changed.
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the changed behavior.
